mapper.select: SELECT d.*,u.username as uName FROM u_daily_flow d LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON d.made = u.id ORDER BY record_time DESC
SELECT DISTINCT YEAR(record_time) as `years` FROM u_daily_flow WHERE made = #{userId} ORDER BY `years` DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.record_time, CONCAT('',#{search},'')) as consumption_time,ABS(SUM(cost)) as consumption_cost FROM (SELECT * FROM u_daily_flow WHERE `type` = #{consumptionType} AND made = #{queryId}) t GROUP BY consumption_time ORDER BY consumption_time DESC LIMIT #{getCount};
